description: This file contains repository interfaces and their implementations for managing customers, outages, and jobs in an outage management system, using Dapper for database access.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Implementation of ICustomerRepository for customer data access.

classes.name: OutageRepository
classes.description: Implementation of IOutageRepository for outage data management.

classes.name: JobRepository
classes.description: Implementation of IJobRepository for job data handling.

methods.name: GetCustomerByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their user ID.

methods.name: SearchCustomersAsync
methods.description: Searches customers based on query parameters.

methods.name: GetOutageAsync
methods.description: Fetches outage details by outage ID.

methods.name: ListOutagesAsync
methods.description: Lists outages with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: CreateOutageAsync
methods.description: Creates a new outage record with associated location.

methods.name: UpdateOutageStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of an outage.

methods.name: AddOutageUpdateAsync
methods.description: Adds an update note to an outage.

methods.name: ListJobsAsync
methods.description: Lists jobs with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: CreateJobAsync
methods.description: Creates a new job and logs initial status.

methods.name: AssignJobAsync
methods.description: Assigns a crew and user to a job and updates status.

methods.name: UpdateJobStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of a job.

methods.name: GetJobStatusEventsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves status change events for a job.
